packageRules.description: Supply-chain: 7-day cooldown before proposing any newly published version. WHY: fresh releases are the malicious-update / compromised-maintainer vector; a release-age gate lets a bad publish be caught before we adopt it. Vulnerability-fix PRs (vulnerabilityAlerts, above) are exempt from this delay so security patches still land immediately.
Group GitHub Actions bumps; pin to digests to match the repo's SHA-pinning supply-chain convention. Safe to automerge (digest-pinned).
Group non-major npm devDependencies across the monorepo; automerge (dev-only, low blast radius).
Automerge all patch-level updates (low risk) once required CI checks pass.
Never automerge major updates - they need human review.
